title: Would you like a robot companion?
speaker: BBC Learning English

sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Beth. One area of technology which has been in the news a lot recently is robotics – the design and building of robots.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔,我是贝丝,最近新闻里的一个技术领域是机器人——机器人的设计和建造。

sentences.en: Humanoid robots, meaning robots which appear and behave like humans, are being built to help us do everything from washing the dishes to babysitting the kids.
sentences.zh: 人造机器人, 意思是机器人 出现和行为像人类, 正在建设 帮助我们做的一切 从洗碗 和照顾孩子。

sentences.en: But not everyone feels comfortable with the idea of inviting a human-like robot into their home.
sentences.zh: 但并不是每个人都对邀请一个像人类一样的机器人进入他们家的想法感到自在。

sentences.en: Neil, how would you feel about living with a robot?
sentences.zh: 尼尔,你对和机器人一起生活会有什么感觉?

sentences.en: I really don't want to live with a robot.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想和机器人住在一起

sentences.en: I have enough people in my house. With advances in AI, robots are becoming smart enough to develop meaningful relationships with humans.
sentences.zh: 我家里有足够的人。随着人工智能的进步,机器人变得足够聪明,可以与人类发展有意义的关系。

sentences.en: There are reports of people telling their secrets to robot therapists and even falling in love with their robot friend!
sentences.zh: 有报道说有人把秘密告诉机器人治疗师 甚至爱上了机器人朋友

sentences.en: In this episode, we'll meet a home companion robot called Abi, who's making friends with the elderly residents of Melbourne in Australia.
sentences.zh: 在这集中,我们将遇到一个家庭伴侣机器人叫阿比, 他正在和澳大利亚墨尔本的老居民做朋友。

sentences.en: And as usual, we'll learn some useful new vocabulary, all of which you'll find over on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样,我们会学习一些有用的新词汇, 所有的你将在我们的网站上看到,bbc学习英语.com。

sentences.en: First, I have a question for you, Beth. Because it's important people feel safe around robots, engineers design them to look like the friendly characters seen in animated movies by studios like Pixar and DreamWorks.
sentences.zh: 首先,我有一个问题要问你,贝丝。因为重要的是人们在机器人周围感到安全, 工程师们设计他们, 让他们看起来像在动画电影里看到的友好人物, 由Pixar和DreamWorks等制片厂观看。

sentences.en: So, what is the name of Pixar's friendly robot who picks up garbage on an uninhabited planet Earth in the year 2805?
sentences.zh: 那么,Pixar的友好机器人叫什么 2805年在无人居住的星球上捡垃圾?

sentences.en: Is it: a) Roz, b) Wall-E, or c) R2D2? I am pretty certain that the answer is b) Wall-E.
sentences.zh: 是:(a) Roz,(b) Wall-E,还是(c) R2D2?我非常确定答案是(b) Wall-E。

sentences.en: Well, we'll find out the answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后在节目里会找到答案的

sentences.en: For five months during the Covid pandemic, Australian engineer Grace Brown had no human contact.
sentences.zh: 在Covid大流行期间的五个月里, 澳大利亚工程师Grace Brown没有人际接触。

sentences.en: She used this time to build a home companion robot, Abi, with the idea it would provide companionship to other people suffering loneliness.
sentences.zh: 她用这个时间 建造了一个家庭伴侣机器人,阿比, 这个想法,它会 提供陪伴 其他人遭受孤独。

sentences.en: Now, Grace runs her own company, Andromeda, building robots specially designed as company for elderly residents in care homes who don't get many visitors.
sentences.zh: 现在,格蕾丝经营自己的公司 安朵美达, 建造机器人 专门设计公司

sentences.en: Here, she explains more about Abi to BBC World Service programme The Conversation: Abi, who's the humanoid robot that we build at Andromeda – people don't expect humanoid robots to have, like, so much personality.
sentences.zh: Abi是我们在安朵美达(Andromeda)建造的人形机器人, 人们并不期望人形机器人拥有如此多的个性。

sentences.en: She's very, very sassy. She's very inquisitive and curious.
sentences.zh: 她非常,非常的狡猾 她非常好奇和好奇

sentences.en: And I think when people meet her, they're always, kind of, taken aback by… "Oh, she's, like, got a mind of her own."
sentences.zh: 我想当人们遇到她时, 他们总是, 有点, 被惊吓... "哦,她一样,有她自己的头脑。"

sentences.en: When people meet Abi, they are surprised by her sassy personality.
sentences.zh: 当人们遇到阿比, 他们惊讶于她的粗鲁性格。

sentences.en: The adjective sassy means bold, confident and cheeky.
sentences.zh: 形容词是胆大妄为 自信和无耻

sentences.en: Some people are taken aback – meaning they are shocked or surprised by the things Abi says.
sentences.zh: 有些人感到沮丧, 表示他们对Abi所说的话感到震惊或惊讶。

sentences.en: She really seems to be interested and to take care of the people she meets.
sentences.zh: 她似乎真的感兴趣 并照顾她遇到的人。

sentences.en: Abi can also express opinions, and Grace says she has a mind of her own – a phrase used when a non-living object, like a robot, seems to be behaving or acting independently of human control.
sentences.zh: Abi也可以表达观点, Grace说她有自己的想法 — — 当非生物物体(如机器人)的行为或行为似乎不受人类控制时,

sentences.en: Unlike the unpredictable and violent robots which are sometimes portrayed in sci-fi movies, Abi is much more approachable and friendly, even funny – she can blow bubbles from her hand!
sentences.zh: Abi更能亲近, 更友善, 甚至有趣-她可以吹出她手中的气泡!

sentences.en: Her softer design was a conscious decision by Grace, who wanted children and elderly people to interact with Abi naturally and without fear, as she explained to BBC World Service's, The Conversation.
sentences.zh: 她的柔软设计是Grace的自觉决定,她希望儿童和老人与Abi自然地、无所畏惧地互动,正如她向英国广播公司世界服务社(BBC World Service)所解释的那样。

sentences.en: I originally modelled her off the size of, like, a young child – so, like a six, seven-year-old child – so she's about 110cm tall.
sentences.zh: 我最初的模型是她像一个小孩一样大小—— 所以,像一个6,7岁的孩子—— 所以她大约110厘米高。

sentences.en: She's got a whole splash of different colours.
sentences.zh: 她有一大堆不同的颜色。

sentences.en: She's got, you know, large, expressive eyes.
sentences.zh: 她有,你知道,大, 显眼的眼睛。

sentences.en: So, that was – I was very much trying to replicate the kind of approachableness and the endearingness of, like, these different, like, Pixar characters that you'd watch in all of these films.
sentences.zh: (笑声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声(掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声(掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声(掌声) (掌声) (掌声) (掌声(掌声) (掌声)

sentences.en: Abi looks like a friendly character from a Pixar film.
sentences.zh: 阿比看起来像一个友善的人物 从皮克斯电影。

sentences.en: She's the size of a six or seven-year-old child and decorated with a splash of colour – a phrase used when a bit of colour is added to brighten up something which is dull or unexciting.
sentences.zh: 她是六七岁小孩的体型, 并装饰着彩色的花朵,

sentences.en: Abi also has large, expressive eyes. If you describe something as expressive, you mean it shows what someone thinks or feels.
sentences.zh: 阿比的眼睛也很大,很显眼。如果你把某种东西形容为表情,你的意思是它能显示人们的想法或感觉。

sentences.en: Elderly residents who regularly chat with Abi say the robot companion brings them joy and a sense of community.
sentences.zh: 与Abi经常聊天的老年人说,机器人伴侣给他们带来快乐和社群感。

sentences.en: Ah, well, it's good to hear the positive side of a technology which can still seem a bit strange or frightening.
sentences.zh: 啊,好吧,这是很好的 听到积极的一面 技术 仍然可以看起来有点奇怪或恐怖。

sentences.en: And I would like to see Abi blowing bubbles from her hand!
sentences.zh: 我想看到阿比从她手里吹出气泡!

sentences.en: Now, isn't it time you revealed the answer to your question, Neil?
sentences.zh: 现在,现在是时候你 透露答案 你的问题,尼尔?

sentences.en: I asked you for the name of Pixar's friendly robot, who picks up garbage on an uninhabited planet Earth in the year 2805.
sentences.zh: 我问你Pixar的友好机器人的名字, 他在2805年在一个无人居住的星球上捡垃圾。

sentences.en: And I said it was Wall-E. And you were… correct.
sentences.zh: 我说是华尔街 你说得对

sentences.en: Yes! That is the right answer. OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with humanoid – an adjective meaning to have the appearance and behaviour of a human.
sentences.zh: 是的,这是正确的答案。好吧。让我们回顾一下我们学到的词汇,从人类开始——一个形容词,意思是人类的外表和行为。

sentences.en: Someone who is sassy is bold, confident and cheeky.
sentences.zh: 胆大妄为 自信和无耻的人

sentences.en: If you are taken aback by something, you are shocked or surprised by it.
sentences.zh: 如果你被某种东西吓到了,你会感到惊讶或惊讶。

sentences.en: If you say an object has a mind of its own, you mean that it seems to be acting independently, without human control.
sentences.zh: 如果你说一个物体有它自己的思想, 你的意思是它似乎 独立地行动,没有人类的控制。

sentences.en: The phrase a splash of colour is used when a bit of colour is added to brighten something which is dull or unexciting.
sentences.zh: 当添加一点颜色来亮出一些乏味或不令人兴奋的东西时,就会使用“点颜色”这一短语。

sentences.en: And finally, the adjective expressive means showing what someone thinks or feels.
sentences.zh: 最后,形容词表达的意思是 展示别人的想法或感觉。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up. If you've enjoyed this episode then head over to our website, bbclearningenglish.com, where you'll find a quiz and worksheet to practise the vocabulary you've learnt.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍,我们六分钟就结束了。如果你喜欢这集,那就去我们的网站,bbclearingenglish.com, 在那里你会找到一个测验和工作表来练习你学到的词汇。

sentences.en: See you again soon. But, for now, it's goodbye.
sentences.zh: 很快再会,但现在再见了

sentences.en: Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 再见!
